guard: an auth INFO advertisement and TCP reset must not become an authentication verdict or auth recovery instruction

mutations.name: a connection reset is misclassified as an auth rejection
mutations.find: if (e instanceof AuthorizationError) return { ok: false, reason: "auth-required" };
mutations.replace: if (e instanceof AuthorizationError || (e instanceof Error && (e as Error & { code?: string }).code === "ECONNRESET")) return { ok: false, reason: "auth-required" };
mutations.cell: who --json does not infer auth from an auth INFO reset
mutations.expectRed: who --json does not infer auth from an auth INFO reset

why: The actual CLI dials an owned TCP peer that advertises auth and resets after client data without sending an auth rejection. Roster/provisioning/grant cases still use the actual owned nats-server. Controlled auth-copy checks are protocol input tests, not proof that stock Windows receives a broker rejection.
